title: Polynomial time is contained in ZPP
statement: Every language decidable by a finite deterministic Turing machine in polynomial time belongs to the class of languages decided by a finite randomized Turing machine with zero error and polynomial expected running time, where the expected-time bound is expressed by a uniform bound on the sum, over every finite time horizon, of the probabilities that the machine has not halted by each time.
